description: Verify bearer tokens from an OIDC or SAML identity provider. Covers education (InCommon/Shibboleth/eduroam), enterprise (Keycloak/Auth0/Okta), and government (Login.gov). The IdP's subject claim becomes user_id. Requires the identity provider trait (KITH-14he).
title: Identity provider: OIDC/SAML federation
